SUMMARY: Home Expenses by Category does not name the currencies it leaves out
USER_STORY: As a user with accounts in other currencies, I want the category card to say what it left out, so its total is not mistaken for all my spending.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-188 (knowledge/retros/2026-10-02-live-sweep-currency.md, item 4c). Observed: sweep user with default PHP, feed blocked and no stored rates; Home Monthly expenses reads ₱4,700.00 and says "Excludes EUR, USD income and expenses — no exchange rate set.", but Expenses by Category lists Groceries ₱3,500.00 and Food & Dining ₱1,200.00 with no note, while SQL has USD 40.00 Food & Dining, USD 25.00 Transportation and EUR 60.00 Shopping this month. src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx:457 passes DashboardCategoryPieCard no excluded currencies; rules/foreign-currency-rate-of-one-is-not-a-rate.md says left out and named. Screenshot knowledge/retros/shots/188-4b-home-feed-blocked.png. Suggested fix: pass the breakdown's excluded currencies (categoryBreakdown.ts, LED-183) into the card and render UnratedCurrencyNotice in both the ranked and pie views, and in the categories detail dialog.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) With a currency that has no rate, the card (ranked and pie) and its detail dialog show "Excludes … — no exchange rate set."; (b) the note is absent when every currency has a rate; (c) re-run LED-188 item 4c; (d) a single-currency user sees no change.

SUMMARY: Re-importing a converted statement at another rate re-imports its transfer rows
USER_STORY: As a user importing a foreign-currency statement twice, I want the transfer rows caught as duplicates like the expenses are, so a second import does not move the money twice.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-188 (knowledge/retros/2026-10-02-live-sweep-currency.md, item 3c). Observed: a USD statement imported into a PHP account at the feed rate 62.6566, row 1 (-100.00 "Transfer to GCash wallet") made a transfer to GCash, row 2 an expense. Importing the same file again at 62.6566 flags both rows. At a rate of 58 only the expense is flagged (through original_amount); the transfer row is selected for import ("Import 1 row" covers it) and would post a second transfer of ₱5,800.00. src/lib/importDuplicates.ts `matchDuplicates` files every movement (isMovement) only under `transferKey`, keyed on the converted amount, and never under `originals`, although the stored transfer has original_amount 100.00 USD. Screenshot knowledge/retros/shots/188-3c-reimport-rate-58.png. Suggested fix: also key movements with original_amount/original_currency by their original values (direction-aware for transfers out of and into the account) and try that bucket first, as for expenses.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) The same converted file at another rate flags its transfer rows; (b) a transfer into the account is matched by the amount that arrived as before; (c) unit tests in importDuplicates.test for an outbound and an inbound converted transfer at a changed rate; (d) re-run LED-188 item 3c.

SUMMARY: Import dialog has no side gutter from 640 to 799px
USER_STORY: As a tablet user, I want the import dialog to sit inside the screen with a margin, so it reads as a dialog and its corners are not cut by the screen edge.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-206 (knowledge/retros/2026-10-02-live-sweep-tablet.md). Observed: the dialog's left and right gutter is 0 at 640, 700 and 768 (dialog 640, 700, 768 wide), 16px at 800 and 256px at 1280; below 640 it keeps 16px (343 wide at 375). The base DialogContent (src/components/ui/dialog.tsx:65) sets w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] and switches to sm:w-full, and ImportCSVDialog (src/components/transactions/ImportCSVDialog.tsx:424) caps it with max-w-3xl (768px), so between sm and 800px nothing leaves a gutter. BudgetsPage's max-w-2xl dialog has the same gap from 640 to 703px. Screenshot knowledge/retros/shots/206-import-768.png. Suggested fix: keep the 2rem allowance at sm and up in the base (sm:w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] or max-w-[min(…,calc(100vw-2rem))]) so every wide dialog keeps 16px; check the other max-w-2xl/3xl dialogs.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) At 640, 700, 768 and 799 the import dialog keeps at least 16px on each side; (b) 375 and 1280 unchanged; (c) the other dialogs that set a max width are checked at the width where it equals the viewport; (d) re-run LED-206's import item.

SUMMARY: Top categories: "Other, 1 categories" for a single remaining category
USER_STORY: As a user reading the top categories, I want the last category named rather than folded into "Other, 1 categories", so the list says what it means.
DESCRIPTION: Found by LED-206 (knowledge/retros/2026-10-02-live-sweep-tablet.md). Observed: Activity rail at 1024, a filter with five expense categories: four rows, then "Other, 1 categories ₱1,566.42" (the fifth is Transportation). `topCategories` in src/lib/categoryBreakdown.ts folds any tail into Other, even a tail of one, and src/components/transactions/FilterTopCategories.tsx:45 renders `Other, {other.count} categories` with no singular; the Reports CategoryBreakdownCard (`Other · {other.count} categories`, src/components/reports/CategoryBreakdownCard.tsx:92) uses the same helper. Screenshot knowledge/retros/shots/206-two-currency-1024.png. Suggested fix: when the tail is a single row, show it by name instead of Other (in topCategories, so both callers agree); keep a singular for any other count text.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Five categories show five named rows, no Other; (b) six or more show Other with the right count; (c) a unit test for topCategories with a one-row tail; (d) the Reports card agrees.
